plots.source:
# Reusable exact adaptation at the typed-record communication waist.
plot text-record (
    text: Text >> record: TypedRecord
) {
    wrap: record/text-to-typed
    text >> wrap.text
    wrap.record >> record
}

# A non-text record refuses here instead of becoming presentation text.
plot text-from-record (
    record: TypedRecord >> text: Text
) {
    unwrap: record/typed-to-text
    record >> unwrap.record
    unwrap.text >> text
}

# Each completed framed record crosses an explicitly finite ordered queue.
# Queue capacity bounds simultaneous pressure, not the desk's lifetime.
plot bounded-record-send (
    maximum-items: Count = 4
    maximum-frame-bytes: Count = 4096
    frame: FramedTypedRecord >> queued: FramedTypedRecord
) {
    queue: record/ordered-send-queue(maximum-items, maximum-frame-bytes)

    frame >> queue >> queued
}

# The first honest local Desk Telegraph vertical. The queued remote Line,
# receipt/status, and transcript branches are added only with their executable
# closing-flow realization; local framing is not called remote delivery.
plot desk_telegraph {
    keyboard: input/keyboard
    keymap: input/keymap
    message: text/submit-lines(maximum-bytes = 256)
    encode: text-record
    frame: record/frame-typed
    send: bounded-record-send(4, 4096)
    deframe: record/deframe-typed
    decode: text-from-record
    show: presentation/text

    keyboard.key >> keymap.key
    keymap.text >> message.fragment
    message.submitted >> encode >> frame >> send >> deframe >> decode >> show
}

    clock >> peer_observe.tick
    peer_observe.observation >> follow.peer
}

# Reusable light-only pulse manifestation. Sound is omitted by authored
# composition: there is no tone Gear or Cord to skip at runtime.

    >> tick: value/tick@1...
) {
    observe: time/pulse-observe(period-ms = 240)
    light: presentation/pulse

    tick >> observe.tick
    observe.observation >> light.pulse
}

# Explicit enriched composition. Light and tone are separate semantic sinks
# fed by ordinary atomic fan-out and require separately offered realizations.

    >> tick: value/tick@1...
) {
    observe: time/pulse-observe(period-ms = 240)
    light: presentation/pulse
    tone: sound/pulse-tone

    tick >> observe.tick
    observe.observation >> light.pulse
    observe.observation >> tone.pulse
}

# Reusable stateful follower. One explicit initial state is updated by an open
# peer flow; light/audio realization and transport remain separate concerns.
plot phase-follower (

plots.title: Secret Knock
plots.source:
# A bounded timing-pattern Plot. Trigger, clock, storage, and presentation
# realizations remain Host choices made by an exact plan.
plot secret-knock (
    >> transitions: InputButtonTransition...
    >> template_commands: NamedPatternTemplateCommand...|
) {
    # Three presses include two intervening releases; finish on the third press.
    # Six slots admit the release separating two physical attempts as well as
    # the five transitions that describe one three-press attempt.
    attempt: time/pressed-button-attempt(maximum-presses = 3, maximum-transitions = 6, timeout-ms = 1000ms)
    intervals: derive-intervals
    normalize: normalize-durations
    storage: storage/named-pattern-templates(maximum-commands = 2)
    final_template: sequence/final-normalized-pattern(maximum-values = 1)
    compare: compare-pattern(metric = "maximum-absolute-millionths@1", tolerance-millionths = 150000)
    manifest: presentation/structured-info

    transitions >> attempt.transition
    attempt.events >> intervals.events
    intervals.intervals >> normalize.intervals
    normalize.normalized >> compare.candidate
    template_commands >> storage.command
    storage.result >> select(NamedPatternTemplateResult.found, unmatched=drop) >> project(NamedPatternTemplate.pattern) >> final_template.patterns
    final_template.pattern >> compare.template
    compare.comparison >> manifest.input
}

# Reusable finite relative-duration normalization through its typed Front.
plot normalize-durations (
    >> intervals: IntervalSequence
    normalized: NormalizedDurationSequence >>
) {
    normalize: sequence/normalize-relative-duration
    intervals >> normalize.intervals
    normalize.normalized >> normalized
}

# Reusable ordered-event interval derivation through its typed Front.
plot derive-intervals (
    >> events: TimedEventSequence
    intervals: IntervalSequence >>
) {
    derive: time/ordered-event-intervals
    events >> derive.events
    derive.intervals >> intervals
}

# Reusable pattern comparison with explicit semantic policy.
plot compare-pattern (
    metric: Text = "maximum-absolute-millionths@1"
    tolerance-millionths: Count = 1
    >> candidate: NormalizedDurationSequence
    >> template: NormalizedDurationSequence
    comparison: PatternComparison >>
) {
    compare: sequence/compare-normalized-pattern(metric = metric, tolerance-millionths = tolerance-millionths)
    candidate >> compare.candidate
    template >> compare.template
    compare.comparison >> comparison
}

# The Gallery entry is a living ordinary plot: pointer, device, or fixture
# button realizations can drive repeated bounded attempts. The initializer
# emits one bounded Put/Get command pair; storage remains independently
# selected and admitted truth rather than hidden UI state.
plot secret-knock-demo {
    button: input/button
    template: storage/named-pattern-template-initializer(name = "gallery-knock", normalized-values = "333333,1000000")
    recognize: secret-knock

    button.transition >> recognize.transitions
    template.commands >> recognize.template_commands
}
